evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present UnityBench-Mini3D, a benchmark of 77 project-level Unity tasks organized around seven expert-defined skill categories rather than tutorials or genres, with three difficulty tiers.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Game development stresses coding agents in ways general software engineering does not: correctness depends on how engine APIs, serialized scene state, and runtime behavior interact, not on source code alone.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Each task pairs a complete Unity project with natural-language requirements and is evaluated using 1,178 held-out, human-authored milestone tests covering scene structure, component configuration, and runtime behavior.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 21 models and 9 coding harnesses, the average pass rate reaches 80.9% on easy tasks but falls to 35.2% on hard tasks, with just 57.7% overall.
